{{Quote|Sakira. S-A-K-I-R-A. It’s his daughter’s name.|Unidentified Bunker Aleph-One female|<ref name="WS" />}}
This '''unknown female''' bunker officer was assigned to [[Revos Spaceport]]'s [[Bunker Aleph-One]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Storinal]]. In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], During [[Wraith Squadron]]'s [[Mission to Storinal]], [[Garik Loran]] and [[Atril Tabanne]] stormed the bunker and [[Death/Legends|killed]] her [[Control Aleph-One|colleague]] when he tried to draw his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. When she refused to divulge the code to recall the spaceport's [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]], Loran ordered Tabanne to shoot her. She then cooperated and revealed that the code was the name of her dead colleague's daughter, [[Sakira]].<ref name="WS" />
